lines.en: label beachvacation16:
scene mayabeach1
A girl stands on the beach with her hands clasped in prayer-position.
lines.zh: 一个女孩站在海滩上，双手合十，摆出祈祷的姿势。

lines.en: But what could she be praying for?
lines.zh: 可她究竟在祈求什么呢？

lines.en: And in a world where {s}God{/s} god is dead, where do you direct your prayers in the first place?
lines.zh: 在一个 {s}God{/s} god 已经死去的世界里，你又该向何处献上祷告？

lines.en: The answer isn’t important.
lines.zh: 答案并不重要。

lines.en: As long as you have someone or something, it’s okay to wish for things.
lines.zh: 只要你有所指、有所依，那就许愿吧，没关系的。

lines.en: Whether it be mending the wounds that your loved ones obtain as they rush through the thorny bushes of life-
lines.zh: 无论是修补你所爱之人在穿过生命荆棘时被划出的伤口——

lines.en: Or memories of stars that you’ll likely never get back-
lines.zh: 还是那些你大概再也找不回来的、关于星星的记忆——

lines.en: There is always something.
lines.zh: 总还是会有些什么的。

lines.en: Isn’t there?
lines.zh: 不是吗？

lines.en: : The end of the world will be beautiful.
lines.zh: : 世界终结的那一刻，一定很美。

lines.en: : I look forward to the next time we’ll see it together.
lines.zh: : 我期待着下一次，我们再一起看见它。

lines.en: She talks to no one but the water.
lines.zh: 她没有在跟任何人说话，只有海水。

lines.en: Or the sky.
lines.zh: 或者天空。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell.
lines.zh: 说不清楚。

lines.en: But her words are like vapor.
lines.zh: 但她的话语如雾气一般。

lines.en: They disperse and float there for moments before disappearing.
lines.zh: 它们弥散开来，漂浮片刻，然后消失不见。

lines.en: Just as we all do.
lines.zh: 正如我们所有人一样。

lines.en: Just as all things do.
lines.zh: 正如世间万物一样。

lines.en: And eventually, her prayers fall upon deaf ears.
lines.zh: 最终，她的祈祷落入了充耳不闻的耳朵。

lines.en: For the Xth time.
lines.zh: 第 X 次了。

lines.en: But what does that mean for the others?
lines.zh: 可这对其他人来说又意味着什么？

lines.en: Where is everyone else?
lines.zh: 其他人都去哪儿了？

lines.en: And if everything is connected then why, on this night of curious nights, has everything gone black?
lines.zh: 如果万物皆相连，那么为何在这个奇妙的夜晚，一切都陷入了黑暗？

lines.en: scene black
Perhaps they, too, have become stars.
lines.zh: 也许，他们也变成了星星。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach1
There is nothing more painful to observe than a girl with a broken heart.
lines.zh: 再没有什么，比看着一个心碎的女孩更令人痛苦的了。

lines.en: And the one you see before you is experiencing that pain for the first of many times to come.
lines.zh: 而你眼前的这个女孩，正经历着未来无数次心碎中的第一次。

lines.en: It’s such a shame, too.
lines.zh: 实在太可惜了。

lines.en: The strength it took to confess her feelings to the girl she watched for years was destroyed before even having the chance to reach out and touch her.
lines.zh: 她用了多大的勇气，才向那个自己注视了多年的女孩告白——却在还未来得及伸手触碰到她之前，就被彻底摧毁。

lines.en: And now she’s been reduced to a bawling mess on a bed with a man who’s having a hard time not staring at her half-naked body.
lines.zh: 而现在，她缩成了一团嚎啕大哭的烂摊子，躺在一个男人床上，而那个男人正费尽力气不去盯着她半裸的身体。

lines.en: But she is crying, so nothing bad can happen.
lines.zh: 不过她在哭，所以不会有坏事发生。

lines.en: Let that be a lesson in life.
lines.zh: 就让这成为人生的一课吧。

lines.en: A lesson in love, even.
lines.zh: 甚至是恋爱的一课。

lines.en: Tears can get you anything if there are enough of them.
lines.zh: 只要眼泪够多，它可以替你换来任何东西。

lines.en: And if you cry with all of your might, there’s a chance you could even drown the world.
lines.zh: 如果你用尽全力去哭，说不定甚至能把整个世界淹没。

lines.en: Drown the world and start again.
lines.zh: 淹没这个世界，然后重新开始。

lines.en: That sounds wonderful right about now.
lines.zh: 此刻听起来，那可真不错。

lines.en: Doesn’t it, Rin?
lines.zh: 是吧，Rin？

lines.en: : Sensei! Sensei!!!
lines.zh: : Sensei！Sensei！！！

lines.en: : Why does everything have to hurt so much?!
lines.zh: : 为什么每件事都非得这么痛不可？！

lines.en: : It’s okay...
lines.zh: : 没事的……

lines.en: : Cry all you want.
lines.zh: : 想哭就哭个够吧。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: Cry all you want.
lines.zh: 想哭就哭个够吧。

lines.en: Drown away your thoughts with screams of anguish.
lines.zh: 用痛苦的尖叫，把你的思绪统统淹没。

lines.en: Let the accompanying headache distract you from your cracking heart.
lines.zh: 让随之而来的头痛，替你分散那颗正在碎裂的心的注意。

lines.en: And build yourself back up so breaking one more time won’t kill you.
lines.zh: 然后把自己重新拼起来，好让下一次碎裂不至于要了你的命。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach2
: Hey...have any of you guys seen Rin anywhere?
lines.zh: : 那个……你们有人在哪儿看到过 Rin 吗？

lines.en: : Rin? No...
lines.zh: : Rin？没有……

lines.en: : I thought the two of you were going to be together tonight?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你们俩今晚要在一起呢？

lines.en: : Well...we were.
lines.zh: : 本来是……

lines.en: : But then, uhh...some stuff happened and she ran off.
lines.zh: : 但后来，呃……出了点事，她就跑掉了。

lines.en: : I was just wondering if she stopped here. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道她有没有来过这里。就这样。

lines.en: That isn’t all, though.
lines.zh: 可事情并不只是这样。

lines.en: She conveniently leaves out the reason {i}why{/i} the girl she's looking for ran off.
lines.zh: 她很方便地略去了她要找的那个女孩跑掉的{i}原因{/i}。

lines.en: But little does she know...right now, the one she destroyed is in the arms of the one that she loves.
lines.zh: 但她不知道的是……此刻，被她摧毁的那个人，正躺在她所爱之人的怀里。

lines.en: It’s been said time and time again today, but we can’t help who we fall for.
lines.zh: 这话今天已经说过太多次了，但我们无法控制自己会爱上谁。

lines.en: Just like we can’t help who we {i}don’t{/i} fall for.
lines.zh: 就像我们同样无法控制自己{i}不会{/i}爱上谁。

lines.en: No one is at fault here other than {s}God{/s} god.
lines.zh: 除了 {s}God{/s} god，谁都没有错。

lines.en: If he created the world, why did he feel the need to give it so many flaws?
lines.zh: 如果世界是他创造的，那他为什么非得给它这么多缺陷？

lines.en: scene black
Why can’t we all have our own worlds?
lines.zh: 为什么我们不能各自拥有自己的世界？

lines.en: Where everything we want can be ours?
lines.zh: 在那里，我们想要的一切都能属于我们？

lines.en: That’s something I’d pray for.
lines.zh: 那才是我会祈求的东西。

lines.en: Wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: 你不会吗？

lines.en: But instead, we’re forced to pray for things as simple as not getting hurt or preventing our loved ones from contracting life-threatening illnesses.
lines.zh: 可实际上，我们被迫祈求的，却只是些再简单不过的东西——别受伤，或者别让我们所爱的人患上致命的疾病。

lines.en: But even then, it’s impossible to tell if it will work.
lines.zh: 但即便如此，谁也说不准那会不会灵验。

lines.en: And all we can do is wait to see what happens.
lines.zh: 我们唯一能做的，就是等着看接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach3
So we wait.
lines.zh: 于是我们等待。

lines.en: And we wait.
lines.zh: 我们等待。

lines.en: And we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait.
lines.zh: 我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待，我们等待。

lines.en: We wait so long that we forget what we’re waiting for.
lines.zh: 我们等得太久，久到忘了自己在等什么。

lines.en: And then we fall asleep.
lines.zh: 然后我们睡着了。

lines.en: The cycle goes on and on until we die.
lines.zh: 这个循环往复不息，直到我们死去。

lines.en: Does that remind you of anything?
lines.zh: 这让你想起了什么吗？

lines.en: Yes?
lines.zh: 想起来了？

lines.en: No?
lines.zh: 没有？

lines.en: It's kind of like a clock.
lines.zh: 有点像时钟。

lines.en: Isn’t it?
lines.zh: 不是吗？

lines.en: Tick tock.
lines.zh: Tick tock.

lines.en: Tick tock.
lines.zh: Tick tock.

lines.en: Tick tock.
lines.zh: Tick tock.

lines.en: Perhaps we can fight time with more clocks!
lines.zh: 也许我们可以用更多的时钟去对抗时间！

lines.en: Maybe, if we gathered every clock in the world and threw them all into one room, time would last forever!
lines.zh: 也许，如果我们把世界上所有的钟都收集起来，全扔进一个房间里，时间就能永远持续下去！

lines.en: We’d gather so many clocks that {s}God{/s} god would be forced to listen to us!
lines.zh: 我们要收集足够多的钟，多到 {s}God{/s} god 不得不听我们的！

lines.en: So when one of our loved ones dies-
lines.zh: 这样一来，当我们所爱的人死去时——

lines.en: Or anything we dislike happens-
lines.zh: 或者发生了任何我们讨厌的事——

lines.en: We can simply turn back a clock.
lines.zh: 我们只需要把钟拨回去。

lines.en: And if he doesn’t notice, we’ll turn back {i}another{/i} clock.
lines.zh: 如果他没注意到，我们就{i}再{/i}拨回一个钟。

lines.en: And another and another and another until he’s forced to listen!
lines.zh: 一个接一个，一个接一个，直到他不得不听！

lines.en: Praise be!
lines.zh: 赞美吧！

lines.en: Destroy the things you hate!
lines.zh: 摧毁你憎恨的一切！

lines.en: scene endofthebeach4
Safeguard the ones you love!
lines.zh: 守护你所爱之人！

lines.en: There is something in this world for you!
lines.zh: 这世上总有什么东西是为你而存在的！

lines.en: And even if {s}God{/s} god doesn’t want you to have it, you can take it!
lines.zh: 就算 {s}God{/s} god 不想让你得到它，你也可以自己抢过来！

lines.en: There is nothing you can’t do!
lines.zh: 没有什么你做不到的事！

lines.en: Just please note that there is an abundance of misery along the way.
lines.zh: 只是请记住，这一路上有着大量的痛苦。

lines.en: No one said taking anything would be easy, did they?
lines.zh: 没人说过夺取任何东西会是件容易的事，对吧？

lines.en: I mean, just look at the girl on the right.
lines.zh: 我是说，就看看右边那个女孩吧。

lines.en: How long do you think she will live for?
lines.zh: 你觉得她还能活多久？

lines.en: It won't be forever, of course.
lines.zh: 当然不会是永远。

lines.en: In fact, I'd be willing to bet that her time here is shorter than even yours-
lines.zh: 事实上，我敢打赌，她在这里的时间甚至比你的还短——

lines.en: But I guess you're a little special when it comes to that sort of thing, huh?
lines.zh: 不过在那方面，我想你算是个特例吧，嗯？

lines.en: Do you think it’s possible to be born so weak and carry on for so long?
lines.zh: 你觉得，生来如此脆弱，却能坚持这么久，这可能吗？

lines.en: Of course you don’t.
lines.zh: 你当然不觉得。

lines.en: Doing so would be irrational.
lines.zh: 那样想是不理性的。

lines.en: But you keep your hopes up because this is all “just a game,” right?
lines.zh: 但你还是抱着希望，因为这一切“只是个游戏”，对吧？

lines.en: If this is a game, then so is life.
lines.zh: 如果这是游戏，那人生同样是游戏。

lines.en: Because nothing is real.
lines.zh: 因为一切都不真实。

lines.en: Shatter the barrier!
lines.zh: 击碎那道屏障！

lines.en: Throw yourself into the wishing well!
lines.zh: 纵身跳进许愿井！

lines.en: scene endofthebeach5
And if you can’t find a barrier, build your own!
lines.zh: 如果找不到屏障，那就自己造一个！

lines.en: Hide yourself away from the things that scare you and tell yourself that they aren’t real!
lines.zh: 把自己藏起来，远离那些让你害怕的东西，然后告诉自己它们并不真实！

lines.en: All that matters is that you survive.
lines.zh: 唯一重要的，是你活下来。

lines.en: Just like how everyone you pretend to love managed to survive the weekend.
lines.zh: 就像你假装在爱的那些人，也都成功活过了这个周末一样。

lines.en: Some with a bit more ease than others, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，有些人活得比别人轻松些。

lines.en: But any moment now, that will all come to a close.
lines.zh: 但随时，这一切就要画上句号了。

lines.en: It was a lot of fun, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: 挺开心的，不是吗？

lines.en: Did you have a good time?
lines.zh: 你玩得尽兴吗？

lines.en: What was your favorite part?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢哪一部分？

lines.en: And if you were there yourself, what would you have done?
lines.zh: 如果当时你也在场，你会怎么做？

lines.en: What do you believe in?
lines.zh: 你信仰什么？

lines.en: What’s your favorite food?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

lines.en: What kind of music do you like?
lines.zh: 你喜欢什么样的音乐？

lines.en: I have so many questions for you!
lines.zh: 我有好多问题想问你！

lines.en: scene tree2
TELL ME EVERYTHING!
lines.zh: 把一切都告诉我！

lines.en: TELL ME EVERYTHING!!!!
lines.zh: 把一切都告诉我！！！！

lines.en: HELP ME LEARN TO LIVE!!!
lines.zh: 帮我学会活着！！！

lines.en: WATCH ME GROW, AS IF I AM A TREE!
lines.zh: 看着我成长，就当我是棵树！

lines.en: And cut me down the second you no longer have a use for me.
lines.zh: 然后在你不再需要我的那一刻，把我砍倒。

lines.en: If all men were created equal, then surely you and I are something else.
lines.zh: 如果人人生而平等，那你和我必然是别的什么东西。

lines.en: Because the two of us are below it all.
lines.zh: 因为我们两个，都在那之下。

lines.en: But that’s great-
lines.zh: 但这很好——

lines.en: Because it means we’ll see things differently.
lines.zh: 因为这意味着我们看到的东西会不一样。

lines.en: And that we'll be able to look up at them from way down here and treat them like stars when we've always had trouble lifting our heads when the air around us gets heavy.
lines.zh: 也意味着，我们能在很深的底下仰望他们，把他们当成星星——毕竟当周围的空气变得沉重时，我们总是连抬头都困难。

lines.en: We're not that different, you and me.
lines.zh: 我们没那么不同，你和我。

lines.en: I can't wait to tell you more.
lines.zh: 我等不及想告诉你更多了。

lines.en: scene tree3
You can see more with your eyes closed.
lines.zh: 闭上眼睛，你反而能看得更多。

lines.en: And somewhere, in the back of your mind, you know that.
lines.zh: 而在你脑海深处的某个地方，你是知道的。

lines.en: Will you blur the line between fiction and reality with me?
lines.zh: 你愿意和我一起，抹掉虚构与现实之间那条界线吗？

lines.en: Will you, too, become a tree?
lines.zh: 你也愿意，成为一棵树吗？

lines.en: We can plant ourselves right next to each other.
lines.zh: 我们可以把彼此种在紧挨着的地方。

lines.en: And spend the rest of our lives doing tree things.
lines.zh: 然后用余生去做树会做的事。

lines.en: We can show each other our branches.
lines.zh: 我们可以互相展示自己的枝干。

lines.en: Our leaves.
lines.zh: 我们的叶子。

lines.en: The wide part.
lines.zh: 最粗的那部分。

lines.en: And our roots.
lines.zh: 还有我们的根。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach1r
: Nothing...will ever hurt this bad again...will it?
lines.zh: : 再也不会……有比这更痛的事了吧……对吗？

lines.en: : There are plenty of things that will hurt just as bad as this.
lines.zh: : 会痛得和这一样厉害的事，还有很多很多。

lines.en: : But I’ll be here each and every time.
lines.zh: : 但每一次，我都会陪在你身边。

lines.en: : Well...unless you move away or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯……除非你搬走什么的。

lines.en: : But I can't really see that happening on account of the whole...isolated town thing.
lines.zh: : 不过考虑到这座……与世隔绝的小镇，我实在想象不出那种事会发生。

lines.en: : Sensei...it’s so painful...
lines.zh: : Sensei……好痛啊……

lines.en: : What did I...do wrong?...
lines.zh: : 我……做错了什么？……

lines.en: : Nothing...
lines.zh: : 什么都没做错……

lines.en: : This is just how life is sometimes.
lines.zh: : 生活有时候就是这样。

lines.en: It’s true.
lines.zh: 真的。

lines.en: It’s true, it’s true, it’s true.
lines.zh: 真的，真的，真的。

lines.en: Sometimes, things are just meant to break.
lines.zh: 有时候，有些东西就是注定要碎掉。

lines.en: For every good vacation, there are ten horrible ones.
lines.zh: 每有一次美好的假期，就有十次糟糕透顶的假期。

lines.en: You should be happy that I showed you the best of the best!
lines.zh: 你应该高兴才对，我把最好的部分都展现给你了！

lines.en: You should be happy in general!
lines.zh: 你本来就该高兴！

lines.en: There’s no time for you to cry!
lines.zh: 你没时间哭了！

lines.en: The clock is ticking!
lines.zh: 时钟在走呢！

lines.en: Tick tock! Tick tock! Tick tock!
lines.zh: Tick tock! Tick tock! Tick tock!

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : I can hear something...
lines.zh: : 我好像听到了什么……

lines.en: : It’s like...
lines.zh: : 就像……

lines.en: : It’s like...a ticking noise...
lines.zh: : 就像……滴答滴答的声音……

lines.en: : Just try to go to sleep, Rin...
lines.zh: : 试着睡吧，Rin……

lines.en: : We need to wake up early tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我们明天得早起。

lines.en: : I...I don’t know if I can...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道能不能睡着……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : But you can...sleep if you want...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 不过 Sensei 你想睡的话……可以睡……

lines.en: : I won’t...leave...
lines.zh: : 我不会……走的……

lines.en: : I promise...
lines.zh: : 我保证……

lines.en: : I'd be too embarrassed to right now anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正现在我也不好意思走就是了……

lines.en: : Okay.
: I’ll see you in the morning.
lines.zh: : 明早见。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: See you in the morning...
lines.zh: : 明早见……

lines.en: My head hits the pillow and Rin's hits my chest after a bit of repositioning.
lines.zh: 我的头枕上枕头，而 Rin 在换了好一阵姿势之后，把头枕在了我的胸口。

lines.en: Her sobbing turns to sniffling.
lines.zh: 她的啜泣渐渐变成了抽鼻子。

lines.en: And soon it turns to nothing.
lines.zh: 很快，又变成了无声。

lines.en: She falls asleep before I do.
lines.zh: 她比我先睡着。

lines.en: And then-
lines.zh: 然后——

lines.en: I fall asleep as well.
lines.zh: 我也睡着了。

lines.en: $ beachvacation16 = True
$ rin_love += 5
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度已提升至 [rin_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Your last night on the beach vanishes as quickly as the prayer of a normal [teenage]girl alone on the shoreline.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你在海滩上的最后一夜，消散得就像独自站在岸边的一个普通[teenage]女孩的祈祷一样快。{/i}

lines.en: label endofbeachvac16:
$ totaldays += 1
$ day -= 6
else:
ERROR ADVANCING TO MONDAY
lines.zh: 错误：无法推进至星期一

lines.en: {i}[totaldays] Days have passed...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}[totaldays] 天已经过去了……{/i}

lines.en: label endofbeachvacation:
: Are you really sure you have everything?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定东西都带齐了吗？

lines.en: scene endofthebeach6
: Yes, Ami. For the tenth time, I’m sure I have everything.
lines.zh: : 确定，Ami。第十次了，我确定我东西都带齐了。

lines.en: : And did you girls really bring your uniforms to the beach?
lines.zh: : 还有，你们几个真的把校服带到海滩上来了？

lines.en: : I...suggested it.
lines.zh: : 是……我提议的。

lines.en: : We still have to go back to[school] today and...I probably would have fallen back asleep if we stopped at the dorm first...
lines.zh: : 我们今天还得回[school]，而且……要是先回宿舍的话，我大概会直接睡过去……

lines.en: : It’s true. Sana’s like, the furthest thing from a morning person possible.
lines.zh: : 确实。Sana 大概是这世上最不可能早起的人了。

lines.en: : Really? Because it looks to me like that role is taken by Maya.
lines.zh: : 是吗？可在我看来，那个位置已经被 Maya 占了。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach7
: You’re...dis...gusting...
: See?
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？

lines.en: : I didn’t...sleep well...
lines.zh: : 我……没睡好……

lines.en: : Sensei, by any chance, do you know what happened with Rin last night?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你知不知道昨晚 Rin 那边出了什么事？

lines.en: : She sent Molly a text this morning about how she went home early, but none of us ever even saw her come back to the room.
lines.zh: : 她今早给 Molly 发了条短信，说她提前回家了，可我们谁都没看到她回过房间。

lines.en: : She even left her bag there. Sana said she’ll give it back to her, though.
lines.zh: : 她连包都落在这儿了。不过 Sana 说她会帮她还回去。

lines.en: Of course I know what happened with Rin.
lines.zh: 我当然知道 Rin 出了什么事。

lines.en: She slept next to me the entire night.
lines.zh: 她整晚都睡在我旁边。

lines.en: Well, at least I figured she did.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少我以为是这样。

lines.en: She was gone by the time I woke up.
lines.zh: 我醒来的时候她已经走了。

lines.en: But she left me a note saying that she was okay and just wanted to shower before[school].
lines.zh: 但她给我留了张纸条，说她没事，只是想在去[school]之前先洗个澡。

lines.en: So at least that’s good.
lines.zh: 所以至少这一点还好。

lines.en: Maybe she’s handling this a little better than I thought?
lines.zh: 也许她比我以为的更能扛得住？

lines.en: I guess there’s really no way of knowing until I see her again, though.
lines.zh: 不过在再见到她之前，大概真的没法知道。

lines.en: : Not sure what happened, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我也不确定发生了什么。

lines.en: : Weird. Well, I hope she’s okay.
lines.zh: : 好奇怪。算了，希望她没事吧。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: You doing alright, Ayane? You look down.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Ayane？你看起来情绪很低落。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 有吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I guess I didn’t really sleep well either.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我觉得自己也没怎么睡好。

lines.en: : Well let me know if you need anything, okay?
lines.zh: : 那需要什么就告诉我，好吗？

lines.en: scene endofthebeach8
: What the heck is this? Why are you so nice to Ayane in the morning and not me?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼啊？为什么你早上的时候对 Ayane 这么温柔，对我就不这样？

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei. For everything.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。谢谢你做的一切。

lines.en: I hope the thing with Kirin yesterday isn’t still getting to her...
lines.zh: 希望昨天 Kirin 那件事没还在困扰她……

lines.en: I’ve never seen her look that...shocked before.
lines.zh: 我从来没见过她露出那种……神情。

lines.en: I’ll have to talk to her again soon and make sure she’s not taking it too hard.
lines.zh: 我得找机会再跟她聊聊，确保她没有太往心里去。

lines.en: else:
: Something wrong, Ayane? You look down.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Ayane？你看起来情绪很低落。

lines.en: : Just upset that the weekend is coming to an end. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是因为周末就要结束了，有点难过。就这样。

lines.en: : I feel like I barely even got to see you.
lines.zh: : 感觉我都没怎么见到你。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach8
: Don’t answer her. She’s very handsy in the morning and will attack you if you show her any affection.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她早上的时候手特别不老实，你要是对她表现出一点亲近，她就会扑上来。

lines.en: : You don’t even want to know where she was touching {i}me{/i} when I woke up.
lines.zh: : 你根本不会想知道我醒来的时候，她的手放在{i}我{/i}哪儿。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach9
: In my defense...it was definitely an accident.
lines.zh: : 我得为自己辩解一下……那绝对是意外。

lines.en: : But Ami was the one who fell asleep cuddling {i}me{/i}, so she’s at fault too.
lines.zh: : 但 Ami 是那个抱着{i}我{/i}睡着的人，所以她也有错。

lines.en: : Lies. I did no such thing.
lines.zh: : 谎话。我根本没做那种事。

lines.en: : Umm...sorry for...interrupting but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉……打断一下，不过……

lines.en: : The bus should be getting here in five minutes and we still need to make it to the stop.
lines.zh: : 巴士应该还有五分钟就到了，我们还得赶到车站去。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach10
: Yeah...Sana’s right. We should probably get a move on.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sana 说得对。我们差不多该走了。

lines.en: scene endofthebeach11
: Are you sure you-
lines.zh: : 你确定你——

lines.en: : Yes, Ami. I’m sure I have everything.
lines.zh: : 确定，Ami。我确定我东西都带齐了。

lines.en: scene black
And so vacation comes to a close.
lines.zh: 就这样，假期落下了帷幕。

lines.en: The five of us board the bus and hop off at the stop nearest to the[school].
lines.zh: 我们五个人上了巴士，在离[school]最近的那一站下了车。

lines.en: I give the girls a bit of a head start so it doesn’t seem like I arrived with all of them at once.
lines.zh: 我让女孩们先走一步，这样看起来就不像我和她们所有人同时到的。

lines.en: Ami is one thing because she’s my [niece], but I’m pretty sure {i}someone{/i} would wind up getting the wrong idea if I brought half of my class with me.
lines.zh: Ami 还好说，因为她是我的 [niece]，但要是我带着半个班的人一起来，我敢肯定{i}有人{/i}会想歪。

lines.en: Either way, I’m a little bummed to see life going back to how it normally is.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，看到生活又要回到原本的样子，我还是有点失落的。

lines.en: But I guess this isn't the last chance for something like this.
lines.zh: 不过这大概也不是最后一次了吧。

lines.en: All things considered...
lines.zh: 总的来说……

lines.en: It was definitely a weekend to remember.
lines.zh: 这绝对是个值得铭记的周末。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You’ve completed the first ever special update for Lessons in Love!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你已完成了 Lessons in Love 有史以来第一个特别更新！{/i}

lines.en: {i}More experiences like this are bound to happen in the future...But for now, it’s time to go back to normal.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}未来肯定还会有更多这样的经历……但此刻，是时候回到日常了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I hope you had a good time!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}希望你玩得开心！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschool
